usage_notes.hunyuan: Built-in prompt rewrite feature - detailed prompts work best. Supports text-to-video and image-to-video modes. Use 'fastHunyuan' for speed.
usage_notes.kling: Excellent for dynamic content with motion. Supports negative prompts. Duration: 5s or 10s. Handles complex layered prompts well.
usage_notes.luma: Best for cinematic smooth motion. Supports keyframes. Duration: 5s or 10s. Excels at camera movement descriptions.
